title: PatchCon: Patch-aware Weighted Supervised Contrastive Learning for Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.06583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated vulnerability detection is critical for securing modern software systems, yet existing learning-based approaches often treat functions as independent samples and underuse the supervision provided by vulnerability-fixing patches. In this paper, we propose PatchCon, a CodeBERT-based patch-aware contrastive learning model for function-level vulnerability detection. PatchCon jointly optimizes vulnerability classification and supervised contrastive learning, and treats vulnerable-patched function pairs as hard negatives with larger contrastive weights to capture subtle security-relevant differences introduced by fixes. To evaluate patch-level discrimination, we use two pairwise metrics that measure whether a model can correctly distinguish vulnerable functions from their patched counterparts. We evaluate PatchCon on PairVul-Linux through extensive experiments, including state-of-the-art comparisons, ablation studies, hyperparameter

translated_title: PatchCon：面向漏洞检测的补丁感知加权监督对比学习
translated_abstract: 自动化漏洞检测对于保障现代软件系统的安全至关重要，然而现有的基于学习的方法通常将函数视为独立样本，未能充分利用漏洞修复补丁所提供的监督信息。在本文中，我们提出了PatchCon，这是一种基于CodeBERT的补丁感知对比学习模型，用于函数级漏洞检测。PatchCon联合优化漏洞分类与监督对比学习，并将“漏洞函数-修复后函数”对视为具有更大对比权重的困难负样本，以捕获安全修复所引入的细微安全相关差异。为了评估补丁级别的判别能力，我们采用了两种成对指标，衡量模型能否正确区分漏洞函数与其修复后的对应版本。我们在PairVul-Linux数据集上通过大量实验对PatchCon进行了评估，包括与最先进方法的对比、消融研究以及超参数实验。
tldr: 提出PatchCon，一种基于CodeBERT的补丁感知加权监督对比学习模型，通过将漏洞函数与修复后函数对作为高权重困难负样本进行联合优化，显著提升了函数级漏洞检测的精度。
en_tdlr: PatchCon, a CodeBERT-based patch-aware weighted supervised contrastive learning model that treats vulnerable-patched function pairs as high-weight hard negatives, achieving improved function-level vulnerability detection.
